Overview.Name: T Saidanna
Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop
Overview.Preference_Notes: Balanced – include non-veg but not in every meal

Meal_1: Option 1: Egg omelette (2–3 eggs) + cucumber slices
Option 2: Chicken pan fried (120 g) + cooked vegetables
Option 3: RICE RAWA upma (~150 g) + curd
Meal_2 (Main Meal): Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & fish curry (120 g) & vegetable curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & chicken curry (120 g) & curd
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer curry (120 g) & vegetable fry
Evening_Snack (Optional): Option 2: Puffed rice (murmura) with onion and tomato
Meal_3 (Dinner - balanced): Option 1: Egg bhurji (2 eggs) + vegetable curry
Option 2: Curd rice (~150 g) + cucumber salad
Option 3: Paneer pan fried (120 g) + cooked vegetables

Notes_and_Tips: Start meals with eggs, chicken or paneer before eating rice.
Keep spicy outside foods limited during social gatherings.
Avoid eating too late at night after work.
Simple and consistent meals will support both stress control and fat loss.
Try walking for 10 minutes after lunch or dinner for better digestion.
